key_insight: Low-rank biases in learning dynamics can drive generative models toward collapse, either through stable collapsed solutions or slow learning of smaller modes.
engineering_relevance: Training duration and learning dynamics can limit mode coverage, so apparent convergence need not imply that a generative model has learned all features.
method: Express gradient-flow learning dynamics for a general class of stochastic differential equations as compositions of linear operators.
Use dynamical systems and operator theory to relate collapse to low-rank biases.
Analyze collapse mechanisms in variational inference and flow-matching tasks.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports two collapse mechanisms in variational inference and flow matching, but provides no datasets, quantitative benchmarks, or effect sizes.
watch_item: Longer training may address slow feature learning but need not resolve collapse when collapsed models are stable fixed points.
paper_title: The balance between feature learning and collapse in dynamical systems-based generative models
